question: To whom and under what test condition must a particular teaching be given rather than withheld?
premises: A particular teaching is marked as something to be given.
It is to be given to one who has prior accomplishment.
That recipient must have been tested for one full year.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one previously accomplished and tested for one year.
uncertainties: The nature of the test is not specified by this verse.
plain_english: This teaching is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year.
